notes: The README only links to docs.koel.dev, but that site is built from the in-repo docs/ folder, which was used here. docs/development.md says only `composer install`, `pnpm install`, `composer dev` and leaves out the app key, database and migrations, so on its own it does not give a working app. getting-started.md (Building from Source) fills that gap with `composer koel:init`, an interactive wizard. It generates APP_KEY, asks for DB credentials and writes them to .env, migrates, seeds an admin account (shown at the end), runs storage:link, asks for a media path, and runs pnpm install plus pnpm run build unless given --no-assets. That covers key:generate, migrate, db:seed and build-assets, so they are not listed separately. CI only runs composer install (whose post-install hook copies .env), key:generate and tests. Runtimes: composer.json requires PHP >=8.3 and package.json engines require Node ^22.18 || ^24.11 || >=26, with CI on 8.3 and 22. getting-started.md still says PHP >=8.2 and Node >=20 (stale). MySQL is only the template default; the wizard also accepts PostgreSQL or SQLite.
